description: This file implements a handler for accessing and querying call log data on Android devices. It defines data classes for representing call log records and search requests, an interface for the data source, and a system implementation that interacts with Android's CallLog content provider. The CallLogHandler class provides methods to handle search requests in JSON format, check permissions, parse input, perform database queries, and return results in JSON format.

classes.name: CallLogRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a call log entry with phone number, cached contact name, timestamp, duration, and call type.

classes.name: CallLogSearchRequest
classes.description: Data class encapsulating parameters for searching call logs, including filters for name, number, time range, duration, and call type.

classes.name: CallLogDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods for checking read permission and searching call logs with a given request.

classes.name: SystemCallLogDataSource
classes.description: Singleton object implementing CallLogDataSource to interact with Android's CallLog content provider, executing queries based on search criteria.

classes.name: CallLogHandler
classes.description: Main class handling call log queries via JSON requests, managing permissions, parsing input, performing searches, and generating JSON responses.

methods.name: hasReadPermission
methods.description: Checks whether the app has permission to read call logs.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Queries the call log database with specified filters and returns a list of call log records.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch
methods.description: Handles a call log search request in JSON format, checks permissions, parses input, performs search, and constructs JSON result.

methods.name: parseSearchRequest
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a CallLogSearchRequest object with proper validation and defaults.

methods.name: callLogJson
methods.description: Converts a CallLogRecord object into a JSON object for output.
